title: Reactions to his talent and when he realized he was special
summary: People treated him well; he only realized he had something special at 'Bama State.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: What kind of reactions did you get from people during this time that you were able to just pick up all of these instruments and do all of these things so easily at such a young age?

Oh, they was, I got very good reaction from them. At that time, I didn't know. You know, at the time I wasn't paying too much attention. I got very good reaction. The people would just come and pick me up and get me on account of that. They treated me real swell. I didn't have to worry about nothing during that time, not knowing what was going on. The reason why.
Right. When did you first realize that you had something special?
Not until then. I didn't pay too much to it. I was just enjoying myself at Tuggle and Birmingham, you know.
I liked that, and I liked to go out before that and go out and play a little tennis. I play a little football too. I could do that once without heading back into the band room for music.
